headline.metric: Free cash flow before working capital

takeaways: Adjusted EPS of $1.91 cleared the $1.46 LSEG consensus (Reuters) by a wide margin; Zacks had $1.43 (AP).
Principal debt fell to $10.0 billion after $10.4 billion retired since the start of 2026, a milestone the CEO called out.
Operating cash flow was $4.1 billion and free cash flow before working capital $2.8 billion on $1.3 billion of capital spending.
Realized crude averaged $85.91 a barrel, down 11% from Q2; production of 1,427 Mboed beat the guidance midpoint, and midstream and marketing came in above the high end of guidance.
Revenue figures differ by outlet (Seeking Alpha $6.56B, AP/Zacks $6.77B), so this page does not score revenue. The earnings call is Nov 10 at 1 p.m. ET.
verdict: Oxy beat the profit estimate by a mile and finally got its debt under $10 billion, which is the corporate version of paying off the car. Lower oil prices took a bite, but cash flow stayed fat. Revenue numbers disagree depending on who you ask, so we're staying out of that fight.
